title: Review pages: designs on a choice slide side by side

labels.today: A pick-one slide with two designs, each folded and opened

steps.path: Any pick-one slide whose designs are each two pictures (practice pictures shown)
steps.headline: On a pick-one slide, every design now sits side by side, even when each design is two pictures.
steps.changed: Designs on a pick-one slide are never stacked any more; they shrink until all of them fit in one row. Three tall designs open at the width of the row, and the pictures scroll for the rest.
steps.notice: Design A and Design B can be compared at a glance, with the answer buttons below them instead of covering the second one. They are smaller; the + button zooms in.
steps.risk: With many wide designs on a small window, each can get small enough to need the zoom.
